title: LIN Unpack
text: Unpack signals from data frame by using configuration in LIN description file, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Select Frame} sets LIN frame; {LDF File Name} sets the file path and {Frame ID} sets the lIN frame ID. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Lin_data_8_bytes
ports.summary: input LIN data to unpack LIN data

params.name: LDF File Name
params.values: File path of LDF empty (default) | character vector | string scalar

params.name: Select Frame
params.values: LIN frame None (default) | character vector | string scalar
